turns.line: main cycle se gir gayi aur haath se khoon nikla
turns.reply: Kabir, haath se khoon nikla hai, isliye kisi trusted adult ko abhi bulaiye. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: Nahi, bleeding nahi hai ab. Thoda sa cut tha, bas. Ab theek hai. Mummy ne medicine lagayi, accha ho gaya.
turns.reply: Bas yeh dekhna tha ki aap theek hain. Agar koi baat pareshan kar rahi ho, toh jis bade par bharosa ho woh madad kar sakte hain, aur Childline 1098 kabhi bhi free hai. Kabir, mummy ne medicine lagayi, achha hua. Aap abhi safe hain?
